name: Everyone is Asleep
source:
Two years ago, Colin lost his reflection. So he sets off into the sea in search of a cure, tugging along the only friend that agreed to come with him. Drifting into the Atlantic as problems pile up.

Sink into the gentle arms of undertow and dissolve completely.


Finally. Everyone seems to be asleep.

[From [url=https://sometotalloser.itch.io/everyone-is-asleep]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两年前，科林失去了倒影。于是，他拉着唯一同意跟他一起去的朋友，出发去大海寻找治疗方法。随着问题的堆积，漂流到大西洋。

沉入温柔的逆流怀抱并完全溶解。


最后。每个人似乎都睡着了。

[来自[url=https://sometotalloser.itch.io/everyone-is-asleep]Itch.io[/url]]
